test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 28 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: What is the major aim of the INSPIRE Awards 'MANAK' being executed by the Department of Science and Technology, Government of India?

options.text: To motivate students studying in classes 6 to 10
To motivate farmers who are doing commercial agriculture
To motivate scientists for technological development
To motivate scientists for space related research

solution:
The main objective of the INSPIRE Awards 'MANAK' is to motivate students at early age and studying in classes 6 to 10.

Hence, **"Option 1"** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**The first component i.e. INSPIRE Award MANAK (Million Minds Augmenting National Aspiration and Knowledge) scheme, previously known as INSPIRE Award Scheme, is being implemented through State and UT governments with objectives:

(i) to attract young students to study science and pursue research career

(ii) to promote creative thinking and foster a culture of innovation among them.
